This pretty home is nestled in the coveted neighborhood of Magnolia Cottages by the Sea, located in Old Seacrest Beach, FL. This spacious and charming home is steps away from your private deeded beach access ( 2-minute golf cart ride) and a mere 150 feet from the resort-like community pool. VITAMIN SEA is conveniently located near a variety of sought-after 30A beach destinations like The Big Chill, Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, surrounded by charming shops, top-rated restaurants and entertainment for families and adults alike. Vitamin Sea is pet-friendly, comes with a 6-seat golf cart and boasts smart TVs in every bedroom, and offers 6 beach chairs and beach towels. The moment you pull up to Vitamin Sea vacation begins. A generous and welcoming screened-in front porch invites family and friends to enjoy coffee, happy hours, laughs and memories You and your companions will love your stay at Vitamin Sea! TRANSPORTATION - 6 person golf cart (with signed waiver - must be 25 to operate). - Bikes are popular on 30A! Should you decide to rent some, a discount code to a local bike shop will be provided with your arrival information HELPFUL NEIGHBORHOOD INFORMATION - Golf Cart Parking: There's designated parking at the front of the neighborhood between Morgan Street and the Waterhouse condos. - Large resort style pool (heated depending on ambient nightly temperatures) - Community green space (located at pool) BEACH ACCESS/SERVICE: - There is deeded beach access directly across from the neighborhood. - In order to sit near the access, you must rent a "set" (2 chairs and an umbrella) otherwise you may use the access and walk 2 minutes to the right or 4 minutes to the left to the public access. - Beach Service is provided by a local vendor; information provided after booking. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12): PRIMARY BEDROOM: 1st floor, king bed, 55” Smart TV, Walk-in-Closet, Private bath KING BEDROOM: 2nd floor, king bed, 55” Smart TV, Walk-in-Closet, private bath; private outdoor shower KING BEDROOM: 2nd floor, King bed, 42” Smart TV, private bath BUNK ROOM: 2 sets of twin XL over queen bunks, 55” Smart TV, private bathroom FEATURES: - 30A – 4 Bedroom / 4.5 Bathroom House - Sleeps 12 (King, King, King, 2 TXL/Queen bunks) - Golf Cart - waiver required prior to use; must be 25 to operate. Drivers license and proof of insurance is required. - 6 beach chairs,6 beach towels and beach toys. - Gas grill - Huge Screened-in Porch with glass door panels able to open up into the living room. - Fully Appointed Kitchen - Professional Ice Maker - Full Size Washer & Dryer - TV in Living Room & Bedrooms equipped with cable and streaming apps - 65” Smart TV in Living Room - Wifi throughout the house. - Dual Zoned Heating and cooling. - Parking for 2 cars in driveway and 1 in gravel area adjacent to driveway. - Pet Friendly: Dog must be under 50 lbs, no puppies, must be housebroken and fitted with tick and flea prevention collars. (Additional $250 per stay) - Large Resort Style Community Pool - Close Proximity To The Beach - neighborhood is immediately across 30A from the beach access - 18 Mile Bike Path Along 30A - Close to The Big Chill, Seaside, Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach SECURITY: - This home does have a surveillance device at entry points and exteriorNotesWe love dogs and are happy to provide a dog friendly space for your vacation! However, it's important to note that dogs are not allowed on any of the beaches along 30A. There is a dog beach at Pier Park located at 16303 Front Beach Rd. Panama City Beach where Fido can meet some new friends and enjoy our gorgeous Emerald Coast! A Note on Shared Amenities: Please keep in mind that these spaces are operated by the HOA. Because of this, they are subject to seasonal availability—common seasonal closures may include April-May and Sept-Nov—and we can't be held responsible for unexpected closures or repairs. If you are booking specifically for a shared amenity, please feel free to reach out with any questions in advance!
